name: Disaster Recovery Drills
objective: Test 4 critical failure scenarios and validate auto-recovery mechanisms

disaster_scenarios.name: Database Failure
disaster_scenarios.validation: All queries route to replica, zero downtime

disaster_scenarios.name: ML Prediction Service Crash
disaster_scenarios.expected_behavior: Circuit breaker opens, fallback to rules within 1s
disaster_scenarios.validation: Requests use fallback, no timeout errors

disaster_scenarios.name: WebSocket Broadcast Failure
disaster_scenarios.expected_behavior: Clients reconnect automatically, no message loss

disaster_scenarios.name: Phase 3 Partial Rollback
disaster_scenarios.trigger: Manually trigger rollback from Phase 3 (100%) to Phase 2 (50%)
disaster_scenarios.expected_behavior: Stop new Phase 3 assignments, keep existing users on their variant
disaster_scenarios.validation: New users get Phase 2 variant, error rate returns to baseline
